title: Moses asks to see the promised land
description: Moses begs the Lord to let him cross the Jordan and see the good land, that beautiful mountain country and Lebanon. But the Lord is angry with him because of the people and rejects his prayer. Instead, Moses is commanded to go up to Pisgah and see the land with his own eyes, and to strengthen and encourage Joshua, who will lead the people into the land. Then they remain in the valley opposite Beth-peor.
